channel.title: CIS 575 - Introduction to Algorithm Analysis :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description An introduction to mathematical analysis of time- and space-complexity of algorithms, including worst-case, average-case, and amortized complexity. An examination of various algorithmic designs, such as greedy algorithms, divide-and-conquer algorithms, and dynamic programming algorithms. Techniques for proving correctness of algorithms. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md flags this “may become an elective,” and it’s the confirmed elective-depth home for P vs. NP (paired with CIS 560’s own elective-depth NP-completeness content) on top of the required CIS 300/301 algorithmic foundation.
